build_VariationalInfer: build a VariationalInfer instance with queries to guides mapping and observations for variational inference
run_VariationalInfer_infer: run variational inference for a specified number of optimizer steps and return a VariationalWorld
run_VariationalInfer_step: run a single step of variational inference with Monte Carlo gradient estimation and return loss
run_VariationalInfer_initialize_world: run initialize_world to create a VariationalWorld with guide samples replacing corresponding queries
review_VariationalInfer_optimizer: review the VariationalInfer class to customize the optimizer function for variational parameter optimization
